description: Re-Elect Mike Motschenbacher Mike Motschenbacher is a longtime Bismarck resident, husband, and father. After graduating from college in 1992, he stayed in Bismarck and is proud to call it his home. Mike and his wife Buffy have been married for 25 years and have four children Carson (22), Molly (19), Emily (18) and Zack (15).
